metadata.architecture: one-dimensional causal attention decoder with a parameter-free attention residual, dual sinusoidal positions, and tied readout
metadata.author: declarative architecture search
metadata.mechanism_hypothesis: A parameter-free residual around causal attention will preserve local token and position features while adding contextual carry information, improving accuracy at unchanged parameter count.
metadata.name: Scalar Residual Dual-Position Attention Decoder
metadata.research_current_explanation: Dual positional injection gives attention alignment information but scored 0.0, so loss of local token features through the attention-only path may be limiting prediction.
metadata.research_decision_rule: Retain only if the graph is valid, preserves the frozen public eligibility floor, and improves public accuracy without increasing trusted parameter count.
metadata.research_evidence: The current 19-parameter dual-position attention graph scored 0.0, and no eligible portfolio result supports retaining an attention-only information path.
metadata.research_expected_result: The residual path should improve digit prediction by preserving token identity and aligned position while causal attention contributes operand and carry context.
metadata.research_next_experiment: Add a parameter-free residual connection from the pre-attention positional representation around causal attention while leaving the remaining architecture unchanged.
metadata.research_previous_interpretation: Giving scalar attention direct positional information was insufficient to produce a positive public score, motivating preservation of its input through a residual path.
